acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme morphological irregularity on the right side of the visible fluke structure, characterized by at least four large, contiguous bulbous protrusions that disrupt the standard linear trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Severe bilateral asymmetry; the left fluke lobe presents as a relatively thin, straight wedge-shaped silhouette, while the right side is composed of irregular, lumpy tissue masses.
